dict.string: Gary 2.0 - Process daily pick results and prior-day football proof 5x/day, first at 2:00am local so the overnight slate grades before morning. Steps inlined because launchd's bash is TCC-blocked from READING script files in ~/Desktop — it can still cd there and exec node, which holds the grant.

array.string: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="/Users/adam.preda/.local/share/gary/runtimes/node-v22.23.2-darwin-arm64/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; cd /Users/adam.preda/Gary2.0/gary2.0 || exit $?; gary_status=0; run_stage() { gary_label=$1; gary_cap=$2; shift 2; gary_try=0; while :; do gary_try=$((gary_try+1)); gary_t0=$(date +%s); perl -e 'alarm shift @ARGV; exec @ARGV or exit 127' "$gary_cap" "$@"; gary_rc=$?; gary_dt=$(( $(date +%s) - gary_t0 )); if [ "$gary_rc" -ne 0 ] && [ "$gary_rc" -ne 142 ] && [ "$gary_dt" -le 15 ] && [ "$gary_try" -lt 3 ]; then echo "$gary_label died within ${gary_dt}s (rc=$gary_rc) — startup retry $gary_try/2 after 5s (Sep 2 2026: launchd node EINTR uv_cwd)" >&2; sleep 5; continue; fi; break; done; if [ "$gary_rc" -eq 142 ]; then echo "$gary_label HARD-CAPPED at ${gary_cap}s — killed so it cannot hold the next run's slot" >&2; fi; if [ "$gary_rc" -ne 0 ]; then echo "$gary_label failed (rc=$gary_rc)" >&2; [ "$gary_status" -ne 0 ] || gary_status=$gary_rc; fi; }; run_stage "all results" "${GARY_CAP_RESULTS:-1800}" node scripts/run-all-results.js; run_stage "football proof" "${GARY_CAP_PROOF:-900}" /usr/bin/lockf -t 0 -k /tmp/gary-live-maintenance.lock node scripts/run-live-football-proof.js --date "$(TZ=America/New_York date -v-1d +%F)" --league NFL,NCAAF; run_stage "insight grading" "${GARY_CAP_GRADING:-600}" node run-grade-insights.js; run_stage "market pulse" "${GARY_CAP_PULSE:-600}" node run-market-pulse.js; exit "$gary_status"
